name: player_update_status_meter
description: Player::UpdateStatusMeter applies status-meter deltas or full refills, updates HUD status text, stops regen velocity, and clears damage state on refill.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native Player status-meter tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43b660 validates the mode split, full-refill path using masterCommonData->maxHealth, refill/repair top-message ids 0x902 and 0x246, regenSkinFxEntry velocity stop, damage-state reset, nonzero-mode delta application, percent-gain message id 0x903, and return value 1.
The native Player status-meter smoke verifies nonzero-mode additive ratio/HUD updates and zero-mode max refill plus damage-flag reset behavior.
